'''Capo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who served in the [[Peace Brigade]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. As of [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], Capo was serving as the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Peace Brigade Fleet]].<ref name="Ylesia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Walter Jon Williams]] likely intended the Rodian Peace Brigader Admiral Capo to be the same character as [[Capo (Peace Brigade)|Capo]], a Rodian Peace Brigader who appeared in the earlier novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''. However, the original Capo was killed in that book, rendering this Capo a new character.
